added: Added Linux arm64 tunnel container images alongside amd64.
breaking: The tunnel gateway now uses an integrated HTTP relay instead of the separate relay deployment. Migrate existing deployments and upgrade the server and clients together; older clients cannot use the new relay configuration.
Removed the tunnel server's external relay URL, relay QUIC port and public-host settings. Control and relay connections now share the client's configured server URL.
changed: Batch plugin reloads now check sources in parallel before applying successful changes sequentially, with failures reported per source without blocking other items.
Plugin package maintenance disables automatic npm audit and funding checks to avoid unrelated network requests delaying operations.
The Pi Desk Docker Compose example now uses named volumes instead of host bind mounts. Back up and migrate existing data before switching; changing mounts does not migrate data automatically.
Tunnel API public addresses now follow the request's Host header rather than a server-wide public-host setting.
features: Deploy the tunnel gateway and HTTP relay in a single container with a shared service address, without separate relay certificates or configuration.

Tunnel containers automatically generate and persist the control key and relay token in a data volume for reuse across restarts and recreation. An explicitly supplied control key overrides and updates the stored key.
fixed: Plugin reinstallation now skips uninstalling package files when the plugin is configured but not actually installed.
removed: Removed the legacy tunnel deployment initializer, standalone relay executable and relay configuration example in favor of the integrated single-container setup.
